title: Cookie banner obscures keyboard-focused Back
scope: Anonymous visitor, consent unset, default rendering, CSS viewport 1280x800; first question after Close restores summary focus.
reproduction: Tab to Close, Enter closes and restores summary focus
Observe focused Back under cookie banner; Shift+Tab then Tab reproduces it
impact: Back label and almost all focus outline are covered, so a sighted keyboard user cannot clearly identify the focused navigation control.
refutations: Not an unreachable or nonfunctional Back: focus assertions and Enter return to introduction succeed twice.
Not a Close focus restoration defect: summary receives focus correctly.

Full-page capture includes sticky elements at scroll positions. Exact live occlusion geometry and assistive-technology effects were not measured; repeated captures support the scoped visual finding, not a general accessibility certification.
proposal: Account for the consent banner when revealing focused controls, using layout space or appropriate scroll margins; verify Back remains visible with consent unset. No input files or website code changed.
